title: 9 Best Animated Witch Movies, Ranked
summary: Studio Ghibli classics, modern Disney romps, and bizarre cult favorites, these animated witch movies feature the very best magic and mischief.
content: Witches have been some of animation 's most fascinating characters for decades, appearing as everything from terrifying supernatural villains to mischievous outsiders and young women discovering their magical abilities. The medium is particularly well suited to witchcraft, allowing filmmakers to bring impossible spells, enchanted forests, flying broomsticks, and elaborate magical realms to life without the limitations of live-action effects.

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 8 Release Date & Time
summary: After overhauling the opening saga, Dragon Ball Super: Beerus faces its biggest test yet by fixing an infamous 2015 story arc.
content: After years of pure torture in Earth's Hell, trapped in a cocoon surrounded by singing fairies and dancing angels, Frieza is finally back in Dragon Ball Super: Beerus . The enhanced remake spent its first six episodes tightening up the God of Destruction Beerus saga, but episode #7, “Resurrection 'F',” brought the Emperor of the Universe back into the picture. Sorbet and Tagoma used Earth's Dragon Balls to revive him, and now episode #8 is ready to kick the Golden Frieza saga into full gear.

title: Fallout: Chicago's 2027 Release Is The Next-Best Thing To Fallout 5
summary: Fallout: Chicago is coming in 2027 to help us forget all about the painful wait for Fallout 5.
content: The release of Fallout 5 is still a very long time away, with almost all of Bethesda Entertainment's focus on getting The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel into the hands of the public as quickly as possible, which is understandable given that Skyrim released all the way back in 2011.

title: The Legend Of Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Remake Post-Launch Release Gets Official New Look
summary: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is getting a post-launch release that fans can finally take a look at.
content: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has been out for less than a month, and already fans are being treated to new releases associated with it. Of course, there's the heavily leaked Ocarina of Time DLC , which is undoubtedly around the corner, and many are suspecting that a Majora's Mask remake is also in the works. However, before any of that, an officially confirmed post-launch release is being dropped shortly for the Ocarina of Time remake.

title: Magneto’s Best Costume Officially Confirmed For New X-Men Reboot Universe
summary: The one Magneto costume Fox's X-Men movies never get to adapt is officially coming to Marvel's new universe in the villain's first battle.
content: Magneto's biggest costume redesign is coming to the X-Men 's new reboot, with an older Master of Magnetism donning the suit to fight entire armies. All Magneto truly needs to be instantly recognized anywhere in pop culture is his signature helmet and a flowing cape. Functionally, the horn-rimmed helmet shields Max Eisenhardt’s mind from Charles Xavier’s telepathy, but visually, it crowns him like a defiant warrior-king who refuses to bow to human authority. Magneto's cape billows dramatically whenever he hovers through the air on magnetic fields, signaling his status as mutantkind’s self-appointed sovereign and protector.

title: Marvel Has Successfully Recast Tom Holland's Spider-Man For The MCU's Multiverse
summary: Marvel has recast Tom Holland's Spider-Man, and the actor cast as Peter Parker has cemented himself as the perfect choice for the multiverse.
content: Marvel Studios has a new Spider-Man for its multiverse releases, with Tom Holland having been recast as Peter Parker for certain projects, and it has worked out pretty seamlessly for the comic book giant despite the actor's popularity in the role. Spider-Man was always one of the world's most popular heroes, with every major Spider-Man movie to date being successful.

title: 9 Most Disturbing Dystopian Worlds In Sci-Fi Books
summary: As society evolves, the dystopian genre shifts too. However, these nine sci-fi books still have the most disturbing worlds, despite time passing.
content: The dystopian sci-fi genre has introduced readers to many terrifying worlds, but these nine stand out for being truly disturbing on another level. Like every sci-fi subgenre, dystopian books ' popularity comes in waves, and it tends to grow during times of political and social unrest. The 2010s dystopian YA boom came just two years after the recession. Then, in the year after the 2016 US Presidential election, the BBC reported a 9,500% increase in 1984 sales. They also shared that Brave New World hit the Top 10 on Amazon and Fahrenheit 451 jumped to 15 on the charts.

title: Netflix’s 2-Season R-Rated Fantasy Series Is A Masterclass In Worldbuilding
summary: This underrated Netflix series is a dark fantasy with the most unconventional and twisted magic worlds and is a masterpiece that fans shouldn't miss.
content: Worldbuilding is an essential part of any fantasy series, as a well-defined setting helps viewers understand a society's magical elements, supernatural creatures, and physical laws, allowing them to become immersed in the story. Striking the right balance is, in itself, a difficult task, since although some entries in the genre offer a detailed exposition of their settings, few series manage to integrate their fantastical elements in an original way. However, one underrated Netflix series has one of streaming's most unconventional and twisted magic worlds.

title: Netflix’s 8-Part Psychological Thriller Officially Debuts With 498 Million Minutes Viewed
summary: Netflix's new psychological thriller earns 498 million viewing minutes in its first five days, securing the series a spot on Nielsen's Top 10.
content: Netflix's The Body is off to a promising start on the streaming charts.

title: The Expanse Season 7 Isn't Happening, But Prime Video Has Found The Next Best Thing
summary: Prime Video isn't continuing The Expanse, despite fan campaigns, but the streamer has already found the natural sci-fi successor.
content: Whether we like it or not, The Expanse isn’t bringing the final three books to the screen, but Prime Video has luckily found the next best option. The streamer canceled the show because of increased costs during the pandemic and lower viewership. Plus, the books have an almost 30-year time jump between Babylon’s Ashes and Persepolis Rising , which would have made continuing the adaptation difficult. If they were going to end the show early, this was the most natural stopping point.
